Requirement: Exclude certification and paid calculation dependencies.
Acceptance_evidence: Architecture and dependency review identify no approval workstream or mandatory paid calculation service.

Requirement: Keep core workflows possible without cloud AI.
Acceptance_evidence: A supported assessment can be entered, calculated, reviewed, and exported with all AI services disabled.
All evidence, extracted records, models, runs, reports, and shares reference a valid project/property boundary.
Supported-case matrix blocks unsupported released operations and labels experimental features.
Dependency and data inventory includes exact release, license, required notices, and source.
Original Truficient identity and required attribution reviewed against selected dependency licenses.

Requirement: Pin and reproduce the selected engineering runtime.
Acceptance_evidence: Clean environment reproduces a documented reference execution using pinned artifacts.

Requirement: Demonstrate design-only execution or document full-workflow requirement.
Acceptance_evidence: Actual command/workflow, outputs, dependencies, and observed behavior are recorded.
Before/after input comparison identifies software-populated values and visible provenance policy.
ACCA/HERS/MaxLoad or equivalent behavior is deliberately selected and recorded; policy changes have reference tests.
Matrix identifies building/system/zone/space/surface coverage including absent space latent fields.

Requirement: Separate reference and modified analysis behavior.
Acceptance_evidence: Patched methods have separate version IDs and reproducible comparisons against upstream.

Requirement: Return errors and warnings as structured outputs.
Acceptance_evidence: Failure/warning test cases cannot display an old result as current or silently omit warnings.
Run includes accepted inputs, engine input/defaults/output, logs, versions, hashes, and method IDs.
Every released engineering method has source/version, applicability, code reference, tests, and limits.
Fields define units, requiredness, unknown handling, ranges, default sources, and result semantics.
Each displayed intermediate result is engine-returned or independently identified; no generated fake engine trace.
Property, project, assessment, space, surface, system, scenario, run, and report records have stable IDs and relationships.

Requirement: Distinguish physical rooms, thermal zones, and served systems.
Acceptance_evidence: Multi-system test models map explicitly with unsupported overlaps rejected or represented.

Requirement: Preserve original evidence and accepted input provenance.
Acceptance_evidence: A reported value traces to measurement/document/assumption/default and source location where available.
Editing a draft cannot change a prior run or issued report; rerun references the new snapshot.

Requirement: Inspect existing WorkEdge integration before duplicating records.
Acceptance_evidence: Decision records identify source-of-truth IDs, authentication, attachment references, and export behavior.

Requirement: Separate real dimensions from display coordinates.
Acceptance_evidence: Zoom/resolution changes leave physical dimensions and calculated quantities unchanged.
Invalid polygons, excessive openings, and inconsistent area definitions are flagged before accepted calculation.
Shared partitions do not become duplicate exterior loads; conditioned/unconditioned boundaries are explicit.
Known independent dimensions validate scale or produce a conflict; axis distortion and page scale are recorded.

Requirement: Support or reject complex ceiling/foundation configurations.
Acceptance_evidence: Vaults, split levels, attic boundaries, and foundation cases have demonstrated supported representations or clear blocks.
Question flow matches scope, preserves unknown answers, and permits incomplete drafts.
A default exposes source, reason, and status; construction-year presets do not become verified facts.

Requirement: Distinguish design inputs from customer scenarios.
Acceptance_evidence: Occupant/setpoint overrides retain method basis and label non-reference comparisons.

Requirement: Separate measured, documented, assumed, proposed, derived, defaulted, and unknown.
Acceptance_evidence: UI and export preserve status and accepted reviewer/rationale for consequential values.
Competing documents or measurements can be viewed and reviewed before input acceptance.
Assumption ranges are labeled deterministic; statistical confidence claims require documented basis.
Upload retains integrity hash, page/revision metadata, and scoped access.
Candidate geometry/text links to source region and remains unaccepted until reviewer action.

Requirement: Handle scans and vector PDFs as different inputs.
Acceptance_evidence: Processing path and limitations are identified; OCR text alone is not treated as measured geometry.
Superseded pages cannot silently change accepted geometry or issued reports.
Schema rejects malformed values; human acceptance is logged before engineering use.

Requirement: Treat source documents as untrusted data.
Acceptance_evidence: Prompt-injection tests cannot grant tools, leak secrets, or access unrelated projects.
Manual mode and provider-disabled tests complete supported field capture without invented data.

Requirement: Expose separate heating, sensible, latent, and total outputs.
Acceptance_evidence: Defined result fields map to raw engine values; unsupported granularity stays absent and labeled.
Component coverage matrix reconciles accounting without duplicated or undocumented omitted contributions.
Reference cases show diversity treatment; no forced scaling to make independent peaks add to block peak.

Requirement: Avoid undocumented safety multipliers and rule-of-thumb sizing.
Acceptance_evidence: Code/report review identifies no hidden padding or area-only capacity rule.
Duct thermal input changes invalidate loads or execute documented iteration with convergence/error behavior.
Independent tests cover temperature differences, power/energy, flow types, nulls, and serialization.
Station, dataset version, conditions, pressure basis, indoor assumptions, and overrides are exported.

Requirement: Separate weather meanings and moisture quantities.
Acceptance_evidence: Current/annual/design conditions and humidity units cannot be substituted without explicit conversion/method.
Comparison identifies changed fields, sources, methods/weather differences, and downstream effects.

Requirement: Do not convert design-load savings to annual bills automatically.
Acceptance_evidence: Reports contain no unsupported energy-cost or comfort guarantee.

Requirement: Separate loads, generic autosizing, and selected equipment.
Acceptance_evidence: Candidate/report labels never substitute nominal size for calculated or actual-condition capacity.
Each reviewed point references indoor/outdoor pairing, operating conditions, document revision, and page.
Reviewed reference tables reproduce expected operating points and reject unsupported ranges.
Capacity comparisons demonstrate no duplicate or omitted fan-heat adjustment.
Supported minimum/maximum, lockout, and backup fields are sourced; missing data remain visible.

Requirement: Do not infer multi-split performance from indoor nominal sums.
Acceptance_evidence: Unsupported combinations block claims or use separately researched manufacturer corrections.

Requirement: Distinguish target, equipment, predicted, and measured airflow.
Acceptance_evidence: Different result types are stored/labeled separately with operating mode and temperature basis.

Requirement: Reconcile room/system delivery without universal CFM-per-ton rules.
Acceptance_evidence: Supported schedules show basis, totals, adjustments, and unserved-room warnings.

Requirement: Track terminal geometry and source-backed performance.
Acceptance_evidence: Released selections include size conventions, flow, loss basis, and unresolved placement/acoustic concerns.

Requirement: Represent engineering graph independently of graphics.
Acceptance_evidence: Stable component/port/connection records survive renderer replacement and round-trip export.
Unsupported loops/zoning/multi-fan configurations are blocked or explicitly experimental.

Requirement: Attach actual engineering identity to symbols.
Acceptance_evidence: Every released symbol resolves to geometry, ports, and appropriate method/data; unknown fitting loss is not zero.

Requirement: Track physical route lengths and overrides.
Acceptance_evidence: Rises, drops, offsets, and manual lengths are explicit and unaffected by zoom.
Released fitting library has source/license, geometry applicability, flow/velocity basis, and tests.

Requirement: Account for pressure rating boundaries consistently.
Acceptance_evidence: Reference case verifies component inclusions, no double counting, and coherent pressure conventions.
Reference cases reject all-branch effective-length summation and expose path assumptions.

Requirement: Separate sizing mode from prediction mode.
Acceptance_evidence: UI/report labels assigned target flow versus solved flow and does not imply one proves the other.

Requirement: Validate fan-network interaction where prediction is released.
Acceptance_evidence: Supported solver passes continuity, pressure, convergence, and reviewed fan-curve reference cases.

Requirement: Check feasibility, balancing, material, size, and velocity constraints.
Acceptance_evidence: Reference cases surface infeasible pressure/flow and do not assume unlimited blower pressure compensation.
Snapping, rotation, routing, deletion, copy, undo/redo preserve graph validity or show broken links.
Physical scale, labels, floor transitions, layers, and layout revision remain identifiable in export.

Requirement: Separate modeled quantities from purchase allowances.
Acceptance_evidence: Counts/lengths reconcile to layout; waste, stock, and accessories remain explicit estimating adjustments.
Schema tests cover IDs, versions, units, run states, structured errors, and supported result scope.

Requirement: Provide idempotent isolated jobs with failure recovery.
Acceptance_evidence: Retry/cancel/timeout tests cannot create conflicting accepted runs or reports.
New input/engine/report changes create traceable revisions, not retroactive edits.
Input/weather/method/equipment/duct changes invalidate affected results visibly.
Every printed number matches run data and defined rounding; no LLM-created engineering values.
Both contain appropriate scope/provenance/limitations with original branding and non-approval notice.

Requirement: Export portable data and restorable projects.
Acceptance_evidence: PDF/JSON/CSV/drawing outputs and project bundle can be reviewed and restored without vendor lock-in.
Customer share cannot access internal notes, other projects, or unselected attachments; revocation tested.
Task tests cover questions, photos, labels, measurements, notes, and missing-input review.

Requirement: Track local drafts and queued sync.
Acceptance_evidence: Interrupted-network tests preserve edits and expose local/synced/failed status without fake offline engine claims.
Simultaneous edits retain base/both versions and require resolution rather than silent last-write-wins.
Negative tests deny cross-project file/data/job/share access.
Upload/process tests enforce limits, validate paths, and prevent shell interpolation/secrets exposure.
Policy documents transferred data, consent/approval, credentials, and privacy-preserving logs.
A clean target system runs supported reference cases from pinned setup instructions.
A restored project preserves evidence hashes, revisions, runs, and issued reports.
Version changes have method/output comparisons and documented migration decisions.
Each released requirement maps to tests, expected-result source, tolerance basis, and observed status.
Reference cases cite derivations; same-code output is not its own independent oracle.
Differences in conditions, geometry, methods, or definitions are resolved before parity claims.

Requirement: Distinguish numeric tolerance from method/input uncertainty.
Acceptance_evidence: Test tolerances are justified by category; no fabricated universal accuracy guarantee.
Documented tests cover supported orientation/glazing/leakage/duct/weather changes with justified expectations.

Requirement: Record architecture decisions and rejected alternatives.
Acceptance_evidence: Decision log identifies evidence, status, consequences, reversibility, and owner approval when needed.
Work reports list requirement IDs, changed files, commands, observed tests, omissions, and review status.

Requirement: Do not build before work-order authorization.
Acceptance_evidence: Research deliverables remain non-executable specifications; coding requests define bounded accepted scope.
